decision: Not adopted: a Common-mistakes row saying rename-project builds only five name variants and never replaces a Title-Hyphen or Title_Underscore spelling.
reopen_if: The template's tracked files gain a Title-Case spelling of its name, or the skill starts covering a re-rename of an existing project.
why: Measured against the template: its tracked files carry only two spellings of its name, lower_underscore and lower-hyphen, both among rename-project's five variants, so the gap cannot bite the rename this skill describes. It bites only a later re-rename of a project that has gained a Title-Case spelling, which the skill does not cover, and rename-project's README already lists the five variants.
